executiveDecision: Hold enrollment and treatment due to multiple screening laboratory failures (Hemoglobin, ANC, Platelets, Creatinine, ALT, AST) and unresolved protocol exclusion criteria.
executiveSummary: Participant PT-1042 presents multiple critical screening failures across hematology and chemistry parameters when compared against protocol thresholds. Specifically, hemoglobin (10.2 g/dL vs >=12.0), ANC (1.1 x10^9/L vs >=1.5), platelets (145 x10^9/L vs >=150), creatinine (1.4 mg/dL vs <=1.2), ALT (82 U/L vs <=45), and AST (76 U/L vs <=40) fail to meet protocol requirements. Additionally, active adverse events including Grade 2 nausea/vomiting following study treatment, a protocol deviation regarding a delayed Day 21 visit for Day 15 assessments, and missing documentation for prednisone dose/washout and non-laboratory eligibility criteria prevent safe continuation or enrollment confirmation.
